extracted text: The joining parts used in this work consist of two materials: an aluminum alloy and a thermoplastic composite. Rolled sheets of aluminum alloy (AA2024-T3) with a thickness of 2 mm (supplied by Constellium, France) were used as the metallic parts. This alloy is mainly used in the primary structures of aircrafts. AA2024 is a precipitation-hardenable alloy with Cu and Mg as the primary alloying elements. Heat treatment (T3) leads to the formation of strengthening phases such as Al₂CuMg and CuAl₂, which give rise to the high strength of this alloy.
